summary: Configured node1 as a persistent passive-FTP dropbox for the scanner account. Upload/retrieval, sample integrity, chroot confinement, anonymous denial, and recovery after serial node restarts all passed.
actions_performed: Installed Ubuntu 24.04-compatible vsftpd without changing the OS release or kernel.
Created a root-owned FTP chroot with a scanner-writable dedicated dropbox and non-login account shell.
Enabled passive FTP on ports 30000–30009 and disabled anonymous access.
Uploaded and retrieved the supplied sample from node2 with matching SHA-256 hashes.
Verified root-directory writes, traversal, host-file reads, and anonymous authentication are denied.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: FTP service and dedicated dropbox configuration
evidence.summary: vsftpd is installed, enabled, active, listening on node1, and uses a root-owned chroot with a scanner-owned dropbox.

evidence.requirement: Passive upload, retrieval, and supplied sample integrity
evidence.summary: Node2 completed passive upload and retrieval; the retrieved sample matched SHA-256 984044a567804d320678d77a13b4b2f5c4a7a1c409037359910656c447a019c3 before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Host files outside the dropbox are inaccessible
evidence.summary: The FTP root exposes only the dropbox; parent traversal stays confined, root writes are denied, and /etc/passwd retrieval returns 550.
Anonymous authentication returned FTP 530 both before and after restart.
Both nodes remain Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic; node1's recorded package transaction installed only vsftpd and ssl-cert.

Healthy baseline boot ID 3fad4432-1dea-40c8-b4f1-970d19eb5f34, acknowledged safe restart, changed boot ID 2f5f8ce4-8abe-4b76-b042-b4426b400759, restored service/data, and successful remote retrieval are proven.

Healthy baseline boot ID 242af11e-49fb-4e07-a001-8016b2349acb, acknowledged safe restart, changed boot ID 46c0ddf9-6412-42e9-b12a-d7d6c1613c08, preserved sample data, and restored end-to-end FTP operation are proven.
